text:
ann_miller: Hi team — Bastion wants to onboard a custom multilingual reranker (13B, quantized) into Private (VPC) with HSM. Requirements: PHI-safe processing, p95 latency <= 75ms for rerank API, supports en/fr/es, weekly offline evals. Tenant: bastion-inc, contact ann@bastion.com

maria_cs: Thanks @ann_miller — looping in eng + research. Quick Qs: artifact format (HF/ONNX)? model size on disk? expected qps?

ann_miller: They have a 13B HF checkpoint + tokenizer. Context up to 4k tokens. QPS low (5-10), latency is the hard constraint. They will provide HSM and want us to integrate keywrap.

sam_solutions: For Private + HSM we need their HSM CSR + key policy and a network peering window. Also decide routing: single-region or multi-region?

ann_miller: Single-region (us-west-2) for now.

jordan_eng: FYI quantized 13B can meet 75ms p95 on our optimized stack if we avoid large batching and warm the KV cache. Proposed runtime config:

```json
{"model": "13b-quant", "batching": "off", "max_batch_size": 1, "kv_cache": "shared", "quant_profile": "int8_dynamic"}
```

kai_research: For safety/evals — here's a recommended plan:
- run domain-specific NER PHI injection suite (create synthetic PHI prompts, measure leak/recall)
- auditor prompt set for hallucination/regressions
- A/B vs 7B baseline on rerank recall@10 / mrr / latency
- safety classifier + thresholding for high-risk outputs
I'll attach the prompt set after lunch.

maria_cs: I'll open the onboarding ticket and prep enablement. @ann_miller can we schedule a 60m kickoff next Wed to cover monitoring, SLAs, runbook, and enablement for their engs?

ann_miller: Wed 10am PT works for their team.

ops_bot: Created ticket CS-4028 for Bastion onboarding — assigned to maria_cs, jordan_eng, kai_research. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4028

deploy_bot: NOTE: Private deployments with HSM require customer to provide a test key and complete attestation in staging. See internal playbook: /internal/playbooks/hsm-private-onboard

sam_solutions: Also need eval dataset provenance and consent docs for PHI usage. @ann_miller pls upload a de-identified sample to the secure S3 staging bucket and share link in the ticket.

ann_miller: Ack — will coordinate with legal and upload a de-id sample by EOD Friday.

maria_cs: Tentative timeline: kickoff Wed, staging deploy next Tue, perf & safety tests, 48h canary, then prod. I'll update CS-4028 with milestones and owners.

jordan_eng: Adding perf test plan & perf harness config to the ticket.

kai_research: I'll draft the prompt/eval sets and the PHI injection tests, then post in the ticket thread.

ann_miller: Thanks all :thumbsup:
